name: Total revenues
definition: Total revenues as reported.

name: Rental / lease revenue
definition: Operating lease income.

name: Net income attributable to the company
Gains on sales of real estate
FFO (Nareit defined)
definition: Net income excl. RE depreciation, gains/losses on sale and impairments of depreciable RE.

name: Core / normalized FFO
definition: Company-defined; definitions differ by REIT.

name: AFFO
definition: Company-defined; definitions differ by REIT.

name: Number of properties
definition: Properties owned (consolidated plus share of unconsolidated, as reported).

name: Total rentable square feet
definition: Rentable or gross leasable square feet of the portfolio.

name: Units, homes or sites
definition: Apartment units, homes, sites, beds or keys owned, as the sector counts them.

name: Annualized base rent per square foot
definition: Annualized base rent divided by leased square feet.

name: Same-store revenue growth
definition: Change in same-store revenue versus the prior-year period.

name: Same-store expense growth
definition: Change in same-store operating expenses versus the prior-year period.

name: Average occupancy
definition: Average physical or economic occupancy over the period.

name: Square feet leased in the period
definition: New and renewal leases signed during the period, square feet.

name: Tenant improvements and leasing commissions per square foot
definition: Leasing capital committed per square foot of leases signed.

name: Average monthly rent per unit
definition: Average effective monthly rent per occupied unit or home.

name: Blended lease rate growth
definition: Change in rent on new and renewal leases combined.

name: New lease rate growth
definition: Change in rent on new leases versus the prior lease on the unit.

name: Renewal lease rate growth
definition: Change in rent on renewals.

name: Resident turnover
definition: Annualized share of units turning over.

name: RevPAR
definition: Room revenue per available room night.

name: Average daily rate
definition: Room revenue per occupied room night.

name: Hotel EBITDA margin
definition: Hotel-level EBITDA divided by total hotel revenue.

name: Total RevPAR
definition: Total hotel revenue per available room night.

name: Revenue per occupied room or unit
definition: Senior housing revenue per occupied unit per month.

name: Operating portfolio NOI margin
definition: NOI margin of operated (SHOP / RIDEA) senior housing.

name: Rent coverage
definition: Tenant or operator EBITDAR divided by rent (EBITDARM where stated).

name: Investment-grade rent share
definition: Share of annualized rent from investment-grade tenants.

name: Top 10 tenant rent share
definition: Share of annualized rent from the ten largest tenants.

name: Cash cap rate on investments
definition: Initial cash yield on acquisitions in the period.

name: Tenant sales per square foot
definition: Trailing twelve-month sales of reporting tenants per square foot.

name: Occupancy cost ratio
definition: Tenant occupancy cost as a share of tenant sales.

name: Realized rent per occupied square foot
definition: Annualized rental revenue per occupied square foot.

name: Move-in rent per square foot
definition: Rent achieved on new move-ins per square foot.

name: Leases signed, annualized rent
definition: Annualized rent of leases signed in the period.

name: Critical IT capacity
definition: Critical IT load in operation, megawatts.

name: Site leasing revenue
definition: Revenue from leasing tower and site space.

name: Organic tenant billings growth
definition: Growth in tenant billings excluding acquisitions and straight-line.

name: Tenants per tower
definition: Average tenants per site.

name: Acres owned
definition: Acres of timberland or farmland owned.

name: Harvest volume
definition: Timber harvested (tons) in the period.

name: Book value per share
definition: Common equity divided by common shares outstanding.

name: Distributable earnings
definition: Mortgage REIT non-GAAP earnings measure as defined by the company.

name: Distributable earnings per share
definition: Distributable earnings per diluted share.

name: Loan portfolio
definition: Carrying value or principal of loans held for investment.

name: Credit loss reserve
definition: Allowance for credit losses.

name: Weighted average risk rating
definition: Portfolio risk rating as defined by the lender.

name: Net interest margin
definition: Interest income yield less cost of funds.

name: Debt to equity
definition: Recourse or total debt divided by equity, as the company reports.

name: Company-reported NAV per share
definition: Net asset value per share where the company publishes one.

name: Property square feet
definition: Rentable square feet of one property.

name: Property units
definition: Units, homes, sites or beds at one property.

name: Property rooms
definition: Hotel rooms (keys) at one property.

name: Property occupancy
definition: Occupancy of one property.

name: Property percent leased
definition: Percent leased of one property.

name: Property annualized base rent
definition: Annualized base rent of one property.

name: Property rent per square foot
definition: Annualized base rent per leased square foot of one property.

name: Property NOI
definition: NOI of one property for the period the table states.

name: Property EBITDA
definition: Hotel or property EBITDA for the period the table states.

name: Property average daily rate
definition: Average daily rate at one hotel.

name: Property RevPAR
definition: RevPAR at one hotel.

name: Property ownership share
definition: Company share of one property.

name: Property debt
definition: Debt secured by one property.
